description: One line of the usage log (JSON Lines). Later versions may add properties; none is ever renamed, removed or retyped.

agent.description: The kind of client, from its User-Agent: claude-code, opencode, maple-harness or other. May be left out; absent means unknown.

ai_units.description: What the request cost in the provider's own units, when it reports them. Local models report none. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0.

at.description: When the request was recorded (UTC, RFC 3339 text).

cache_class.description: How the provider's prompt cache did: hit, partial, miss, lost or n/a. May be left out; absent means not classified.

cache_reason.description: For a miss or a loss, a short reason. May be left out; absent means no reason given.

cache_saved_estimated.description: Estimated: what the provider's prompt cache saved on this request, against paying for the same tokens without the cache. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

cache_write_surcharge_estimated.description: Estimated: what writing to the prompt cache cost on this request above that same price. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the provider's prompt cache (0 when the provider reports none). Unit: tokens.

cached_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the provider's prompt cache (0 when the provider reports none). Unit: tokens.

client.description: The access token's label, or local for a caller on this machine without one (never the token itself). May be left out; absent means unknown.

conv.description: An opaque label grouping the requests of one conversation (never content). May be left out; absent means unknown.

cost_currency.description: The currency of cost_estimated, such as USD. May be left out; absent means no estimate. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

cost_estimated.description: An estimate of what the request cost at the provider's published list prices, from a provider set up to give one. Not a bill, and separate from ai_units: never add the two together. Unit: cost_currency. May be left out; absent means no estimate. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

duration_ms.description: How long the request took. Unit: milliseconds.

error.description: Why the request failed, if it did. May be left out; absent means no error.

fallback.description: Whether the request was answered by a fallback after the first choice failed. May be left out; absent means false.

images_cost_estimated.description: Estimated: the prompt-cache rewrite a newly replaced image cost on this request. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

images_saved_estimated.description: Estimated: what sending fewer image tokens saved on this request. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

images_saved_tokens_estimated.description: Estimated from each provider's published image formula: image tokens avoided by resizing or replacing images in this request. Unit: tokens. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens, as the provider reported them. Unit: tokens.

messages.description: Messages in the request. Unit: count.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens, as the provider reported them. Unit: tokens.

prefix.description: An opaque grouping label (never content). May be left out; absent means unknown.

priced.description: Whether the proxy could put an AI-unit value on this request's savings, which needs a few earlier requests to the same model. When false, the AI-unit savings columns are 0 because nothing was valued, not because nothing was saved. May be left out; absent means false. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

requested.description: The model name the client asked for (may be a routing alias such as auto).

schema_version.description: The schema version the line was written with. May be left out; absent means 1. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

session.description: An opaque id a client sends to group its requests into one session; Maple Harness sends its session's id (never content). May be left out; absent means unknown. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

setup.description: An opaque grouping label (never content). May be left out; absent means unknown.

snapshots_cost_estimated.description: Estimated: a request that only asked again for a snapshot straight after a trimmed one. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

snapshots_saved_estimated.description: Estimated: what leaving those snapshot tokens out saved on this request. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

snapshots_saved_tokens_estimated.description: Estimated (characters divided by four): tokens left out of browser page snapshots in this request. Unit: tokens. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

stabiliser_saved_estimated.description: Estimated: what the prefix stabiliser saved on this request. Shown on the Savings card on its own line, not in its headline. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

surface.description: The API the caller used: chat (OpenAI-compatible) or messages (Anthropic-compatible). May be left out; absent means unknown.

tools.description: Tool definitions sent with the request. Unit: count.

trim_cost_estimated.description: Estimated: what trimming cost on this request: rewriting the prompt cache after a batch of trimming, and a request that only repeated a call whose result was trimmed. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

trim_saved_estimated.description: Estimated: what trimming saved on this request, valued at the price of a cached token, the lowest a resent token can cost. Negative when the model asked again for a trimmed result and an earlier saving was taken back. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

trim_saved_tokens_estimated.description: Estimated from their length: tokens that trimming left out of this request. Unit: tokens. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

warming.description: Whether the proxy sent this request itself, to keep a provider's prompt cache from expiring while a conversation was idle. What it cost is in ai_units. May be left out; absent means false. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

warming_expected_saved_estimated.description: Estimated, on a cache-warming request: the saving expected when it was sent, not a confirmed outcome. Shown on the Savings card on its own line, not in its headline. Unit: AI units. May be left out; absent means 0. Added in schema version 2: lines written before it do not have it.

title: Maple usage record, schema version 2
